title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.&nbsp;<br><br>Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. <br><br>Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.</p></div><table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <div><strong>The role, in a nutshell:</strong><br>As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Success Planning &amp; Value: Drive business success planning by partnering with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to align on requirements, goals, and challenges. Provide thought leadership on change management for large, scaled rollouts. Support the full Business Value Realization cycle to ensure customers can demonstrate and prove value internally.</li> <li>Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams.&nbsp; This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influence them to act toward customer needs.</li> <li>Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.</li> <li>Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.</li> <li>Training &amp; Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.</li> <li>Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></div> <ul> <li>5+ years experience in enterprise, customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.</li> <li>Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.</li> <li>This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy.&nbsp; This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve customers.</li> <li>Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.</li> <li>Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>Strongly Preferred:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Previous early-stage startup experience</li> <li>Passion for technology &amp; cybersecurity</li> <li>Relevant hands-on technical experience, in one or more of the following domains: cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, Linux, Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security, security infrastructure, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle</li> </ul> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>We live and breathe our company values:</p> <ul> <li>We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.</li> <li>We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.</li> <li>We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.</li> <li>We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p>A few of the benefits we offer:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible &amp; Remote-First Culture:</strong> Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.</li> <li><strong>Our Approach to Equity:</strong> Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).</li> <li><strong>100% Covered Health Insurance:</strong> We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.</li> <li><strong>∞ Flexible Time Off:</strong> Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.</li> <li><strong>18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:</strong> We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.</li> </ul> <p>If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.</p> <p>Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p> <p>By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with <span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://www.chainguard.dev/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a></span>.</p> <p>©2026 Chainguard. All Rights Reserved.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders)
description: Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich). As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired. One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike. You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. description: Wir suchen … Dich, als Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) (m/w/d) , um gemeinsam mit uns bei thermondo einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Klimaneutralität zu leisten. Wenn Du daran Spaß hast Planungs- und Installationsstandard B2B/MFH aufbauen: Entwicklung, Dokumentation und laufende Weiterentwicklung eines verbindlichen technischen Standards für Wärmepumpen-Projekte im Mehrfamilienhaus im Bestand. Dazu gehören Heizlast, Hydraulik inklusive Kaskaden und Pufferspeicher, Trinkwarmwasser und Legionellenschutz, Elektro und Netzanschluss, Schallschutz sowie Aufstellung. Der Standard ist die Grundlage für Planung, Angebotskalkulation und Ausführung durch unsere Installationspartner. Technische Baustellenbegleitung: Prüfung und Freigabe der Planungen und Angebote der Installationspartner, Kick-off vor Ort, regelmäßige Baustellenbesuche und Qualitätskontrollen, Klärung technischer Fragen und Änderungen im Bauablauf. Du bist technische Schnittstelle zu Kunden aus der Wohnungswirtschaft und zu Eigentümern, Partnern, Fachplanern und Netzbetreibern. Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahme verantworten: Durchführung und Dokumentation von Zwischen- und Endabnahmen, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme, hydraulischem Abgleich, Einregulierung und Funktionsprüfung. Du verantwortest das Mängelmanagement bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe an Kunden und Service. Außerdem standardisiert du Abnahme- und Übergabeprotokolle sowie die Nachweisdokumentation für die Förderung nach BEG und KfW. Skalierbare Operations-Prozesse aufbauen: Definition und Implementierung des End-to-End-Prozesses von der technischen Vorprüfung über Planung, Material und Bestellung, Ausführung, Abnahme und Übergabe in den Service. Dazu gehören Checklisten, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Meilensteine, KPIs wie Durchlaufzeit, Erstabnahme Quote und Nacharbeitsquote sowie Anforderungen an Tools wie CRM, Angebotsgenerator und Baustellendokumentation. Partner qualifizieren und Qualität sichern: Technisches Onboarding, Schulung und Auditierung der Installationspartner auf den thermondo Standard. Du bewertest die Ausführungsqualität je Projekt, etabliert strukturierte Feedbackschleifen und leitest Maßnahmen wie Nachschulungen, Standard Anpassungen oder Partnerauswahl ab. Technischen Vertrieb und Angebote unterstützen: Vor-Ort-Begehungen, technische Machbarkeitsprüfung und Konzeptauswahl, zum Beispiel Zentralanlage versus dezentrale Lösung, Kaskade oder Hybrid und Bivalenz. Du plausibilisiert Kalkulationen, Mengen und Aufwandsschätzungen und bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden in der Angebotsphase. Lessons Learned und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Systematische Auswertung abgeschlossener Projekte hinsichtlich Kosten, Zeit, Qualität und Störungen im Betrieb. Du führst die Erkenntnisse in Standard, Produktportfolio und Kalkulationsgrundlagen zurück. Außerdem beobachtest du relevante Normen, Technik- und Fördervorhaben wie GEG, BEG, VDI 4645, DIN EN 12831 und DVGW W 551 und setzt sie im Standard um. Und Dich hier wiedererkennst Abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel B.Eng., M.Eng. oder Dipl.-Ing., in Versorgungstechnik, Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Technischer Gebäudeausrüstung, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Alternativ verfügst du über eine SHK-Meisterausbildung oder eine staatlich geprüfte Technikerausbildung im Bereich HLK mit nachweisbarer Planungs- und Bauleitungs Erfahrung. Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung und/oder Ausführung von Heizungs- oder Wärmepumpenanlagen, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit Projekt-, Bauleitungs- oder Abnahme Verantwortung. Erfahrung mit Mehrfamilienhäusern beziehungsweise größeren Leistungsklassen über 30 kW und Kaskaden ist erforderlich. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Standards und Prozessen ist von Vorteil. Fachliche Tiefe Wärmepumpe im Bestands-MFH: Heizlastberechnung, Hydraulik mit Kaskaden, Pufferspeichern und hydraulischem Abgleich, Trinkwarmwasser-Konzepte mit DVGW W 551 und Legionellenschutz, Elektro- und Netzanschluss sowie Schallschutz. raw.description:
Wir suchen

Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • Planungs- und Installationsstandard B2B/MFH aufbauen: Entwicklung, Dokumentation und laufende Weiterentwicklung eines verbindlichen technischen Standards für Wärmepumpen-Projekte im Mehrfamilienhaus im Bestand. Dazu gehören Heizlast, Hydraulik inklusive Kaskaden und Pufferspeicher, Trinkwarmwasser und Legionellenschutz, Elektro und Netzanschluss, Schallschutz sowie Aufstellung. Der Standard ist die Grundlage für Planung, Angebotskalkulation und Ausführung durch unsere Installationspartner.
  • Technische Baustellenbegleitung: Prüfung und Freigabe der Planungen und Angebote der Installationspartner, Kick-off vor Ort, regelmäßige Baustellenbesuche und Qualitätskontrollen, Klärung technischer Fragen und Änderungen im Bauablauf. Du bist technische Schnittstelle zu Kunden aus der Wohnungswirtschaft und zu Eigentümern, Partnern, Fachplanern und Netzbetreibern.
  • Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahme verantworten: Durchführung und Dokumentation von Zwischen- und Endabnahmen, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme, hydraulischem Abgleich, Einregulierung und Funktionsprüfung. Du verantwortest das Mängelmanagement bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe an Kunden und Service. Außerdem standardisiert du Abnahme- und Übergabeprotokolle sowie die Nachweisdokumentation für die Förderung nach BEG und KfW.
  • Skalierbare Operations-Prozesse aufbauen: Definition und Implementierung des End-to-End-Prozesses von der technischen Vorprüfung über Planung, Material und Bestellung, Ausführung, Abnahme und Übergabe in den Service. Dazu gehören Checklisten, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Meilensteine, KPIs wie Durchlaufzeit, Erstabnahme Quote und Nacharbeitsquote sowie Anforderungen an Tools wie CRM, Angebotsgenerator und Baustellendokumentation.
  • Partner qualifizieren und Qualität sichern: Technisches Onboarding, Schulung und Auditierung der Installationspartner auf den thermondo Standard. Du bewertest die Ausführungsqualität je Projekt, etabliert strukturierte Feedbackschleifen und leitest Maßnahmen wie Nachschulungen, Standard Anpassungen oder Partnerauswahl ab.
  • Technischen Vertrieb und Angebote unterstützen: Vor-Ort-Begehungen, technische Machbarkeitsprüfung und Konzeptauswahl, zum Beispiel Zentralanlage versus dezentrale Lösung, Kaskade oder Hybrid und Bivalenz. Du plausibilisiert Kalkulationen, Mengen und Aufwandsschätzungen und bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden in der Angebotsphase.
  • Lessons Learned und kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Systematische Auswertung abgeschlossener Projekte hinsichtlich Kosten, Zeit, Qualität und Störungen im Betrieb. Du führst die Erkenntnisse in Standard, Produktportfolio und Kalkulationsgrundlagen zurück. Außerdem beobachtest du relevante Normen, Technik- und Fördervorhaben wie GEG, BEG, VDI 4645, DIN EN 12831 und DVGW W 551 und setzt sie im Standard um.


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, zum Beispiel B.Eng., M.Eng. oder Dipl.-Ing., in Versorgungstechnik, Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Technischer Gebäudeausrüstung, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Alternativ verfügst du über eine SHK-Meisterausbildung oder eine staatlich geprüfte Technikerausbildung im Bereich HLK mit nachweisbarer Planungs- und Bauleitungs Erfahrung.
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung und/oder Ausführung von Heizungs- oder Wärmepumpenanlagen, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit Projekt-, Bauleitungs- oder Abnahme Verantwortung. Erfahrung mit Mehrfamilienhäusern beziehungsweise größeren Leistungsklassen über 30 kW und Kaskaden ist erforderlich. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Standards und Prozessen ist von Vorteil.
  • Fachliche Tiefe Wärmepumpe im Bestands-MFH: Heizlastberechnung, Hydraulik mit Kaskaden, Pufferspeichern und hydraulischem Abgleich, Trinkwarmwasser-Konzepte mit DVGW W 551 und Legionellenschutz, Elektro- und Netzanschluss sowie Schallschutz.   • Bauleitungs- und Abnahmekompetenz: Souveräne Baustellenbegehungen, Qualitätskontrollen, förmliche Abnahmen und Mängelmanagement nach VOB/B. Du triffst klare und dokumentierte technische Entscheidungen auch unter Zeitdruck.

Erfahrung mit Heizlast- und Auslegungssoftware, zum Beispiel Hottgenroth/ETU oder Hersteller Tools von Vaillant, Viessmann und Daikin. title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
description: About FION European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly. We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently. We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors. We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work. You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders. Tasks Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact. Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows. Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models. Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices. Requirements You bring: - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience - Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation - Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules - Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) - Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting - An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets Even better if you have: - Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works - Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation - BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems - Experience with open-source and commercial MILP solvers (e.g. Pyomo, OR-Tools) - Experience with optimization techniques such as stochastic or robust optimization - Experience building forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) - Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products - German language skills (our customers and partners are German) Benefits Ownership, not tickets This isn't a role where the models are decided and you fill in the blanks. The forecasting and dispatch optimization stack is greenfield - nothing exists yet, and you'll design and build it from the ground up. At larger energy companies, this scope is split across multiple teams. Here, you own it all. Real impact, fast Your code runs physical batteries that save real factories real money. You'll see results on a Grafana dashboard the same week you deploy. Founding trajectory As FION grows, you grow with it - from hands-on builder to platform lead to head of forecasting and optimization. What takes 5 years at a large company, you'll have from day one. Compensation - VSOP (virtual shares) - you participate in the company's success - Berlin hybrid (remote from within Germany possible for the right person) Send us: - Your CV or LinkedIn profile - A few sentences on why this role interests you - Optionally: a link to a project, repo, or writeup that shows how you think about technical problems We review every application personally and get back to you within a week. Du erkennst zusätzliche Bedarfe im Kundenbestand, erarbeitest passende Angebote und führst Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss. In strategischen Kundengesprächen analysierst du Ziele und bisherige Ergebnisse. Daraus leitest du konkrete Empfehlungen für die weitere Zusammenarbeit ab. Erfolge beim Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen: Du hast Upsells und Cross-Sells abgeschlossen und Kunden langfristig gebunden. Führungserfahrung oder konkrete Erfahrung darin, ein Team aufzubauen und Mitarbeitende weiterzuentwickeln. Du kannst Kunden strategisch beraten, ihren Bedarf verstehen und Empfehlungen in überzeugende Angebote übersetzen. Verhandlungen und Abschlüsse übernimmst du auch selbst. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit CRM, Pipeline und Umsatzkennzahlen und leitest daraus klare Prioritäten für dich und dein Team ab. Du kommunizierst klar, sprichst Probleme in der Zusammenarbeit früh an und übernimmst die Rolle in Vollzeit. Benefits Vergütungsrahmen von 8.000–15.000 € pro Monat mit starker leistungsabhängiger Komponente. Erfolgsbeteiligung. 100 % Remote und flexible Arbeitsplatzgestaltung. Eigene Verantwortung für den Bereich Account Management und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder. Betriebliche Weiterbildung. Bewirb dich und zeig uns, wie du bisher Bestandskunden entwickelt und zusätzlichen Umsatz erzielt hast. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. description: Livom baut Sofas, die mit dem Leben mithalten: modular, jederzeit umstellbar, mit abnehmbaren und waschbaren Bezügen. Damit sind wir zu einer 8-stelligen D2C-Brand gewachsen. Wir verkaufen online in 5 europäischen Ländern und betreiben Showrooms in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in den Niederlanden. Jetzt kommt der nächste Schritt. Performance Marketing ist unser stärkster Wachstumshebel, und wir legen ihn in die Hände einer Person, die ihn zu ihrem eigenen macht: Team aufbauen, Kanäle führen, Messbarkeit schaffen, skalieren. Bei uns sind die Wege kurz und die Entscheidungen schnell. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und der Geschäftsleitung. Aufgaben Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für unser Performance Marketing – strategisch und operativ. Team aufbauen und führen: Du baust das Performance-Marketing-Team von Grund auf. Du entscheidest, welche Rollen es braucht, rekrutierst sie und entwickelst sie weiter. Kanäle operativ verantworten: Google, Meta und Pinterest liegen bei dir, von der Kampagnenstruktur über die Budgetverteilung bis zur täglichen Optimierung. Am Anfang sitzt du selbst in den Konten. Attribution und Tracking lösen: Unsere Kunden kaufen ein hochpreisiges Produkt, oft erst nach Wochen und häufig nach einem Showroom-Besuch. Du baust ein Messmodell, dem wir Budgetentscheide anvertrauen können: sauberes Tracking, Online und Showroom zusammengeführt, Inkrementalität getestet. Profitabel skalieren: Du führst eine 8-stellige Brand in 5 Ländern mit einem Mediabudget in Millionenhöhe. Gesteuert wird nach Deckungsbeitrag und Neukunden, nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Peaks planen: Black Friday und die grossen Sales entscheiden bei uns das Jahr. Du planst Budget, Pacing und Kanalmix dafür frühzeitig und passt sie laufend an. Performance und Creative verbinden: Du arbeitest eng mit Creative-Produktion, CRM und Shop zusammen und lieferst die Daten dazu, welche Botschaften, Zielgruppen und Formate tragen. Qualifikation Wir suchen einen Macher mit Unternehmergeist: jemanden, der selber anpackt und gleichzeitig sein Team aufbaut. Ausgewiesene Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing: mehrere Jahre Performance Marketing mit eigener Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung, idealerweise im E-Commerce oder D2C. Operative Tiefe: Du beherrschst Google Ads und Meta Ads aus der täglichen Arbeit in den Konten, nicht nur aus dem Reporting. Pinterest-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Tracking- und Attributionswissen: Du kennst serverseitiges Tracking, Conversion APIs und Inkrementalitätstests und weisst, wo Plattformzahlen täuschen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Du rechnest in Deckungsbeitrag und Cashflow, triffst Entscheidungen und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht auf fertige Strukturen. Was fehlt, baust du. Führung: Du hast bereits ein Team aufgebaut oder geführt, oder du kannst zeigen, warum du jetzt bereit dafür bist. Sprachen: sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch. Erfahrung mit hochpreisigen Produkten und langen Kaufentscheiden ist kein Muss, hilft aber. Benefits Remote: Du arbeitest von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest. Beteiligung: Wer Livom mit aufbaut, soll am Erfolg teilhaben. Du wirst am Unternehmen beteiligt. Freiheiten: Dein Bereich, dein Budget, deine Entscheidungen. Wir geben die Richtung vor, den Weg bestimmst du. Skalierung: Eine Brand, die bereits 8-stellig ist und weiter wachsen will. Du testest nicht mit Kleinstbudgets, du bewegst echte Hebel. Ein geiles Team: Leute, die ihr Handwerk verstehen, direkt miteinander reden und Lust haben, etwas Grosses zu bauen. Diese Rolle ist nichts für jemanden, der ein fertiges Setup verwalten will. title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers. Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works. What you’ll do: Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface. Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. raw.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

What you’ll do:

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

What you bring:

  • You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 4 months (6 preferred) and based in Berlin.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Success & Onboarding (m/w/d) – Teilzeit, 20 Std./Woche
description: Baue einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf Novo AI ist ein Technologieunternehmen aus Hannover. Mit unserer WatchMen-Plattform und KI-Sensorik helfen wir produzierenden Unternehmen, Maschinenzustände, Stillstände und Produktionskennzahlen transparent zu machen und ihre Fertigung besser zu verstehen. Damit unsere Kunden schnell starten und unsere Lösungen im Alltag sicher nutzen können, bauen wir unser Onboarding und Customer Success von Grund auf auf. Dafür suchen wir dich in Teilzeit mit zunächst 20 Stunden pro Woche. Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden persönlich und entwickelst zugleich wiederverwendbare Inhalte und intelligente Abläufe. Du kannst Verbesserungen selbst vorantreiben und arbeitest dabei mit Kollegen zusammen, die dich bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. Unser Ziel: mehr Kunden gut begleiten und den manuellen Aufwand pro Kunde reduzieren. Deine Aufgaben Customer Success aufbauen: Du lernst die zugeteilten Kunden, ihre Ansprechpartner, Ziele und offenen Anliegen kennen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Team entwickelst du einen klaren Weg vom ersten Einführungsgespräch bis zur regelmäßigen Nutzung von WatchMen. Onboarding-Workflows gestalten: Du definierst nachvollziehbare Schritte, Zuständigkeiten und Meilensteine – etwa Begrüßung, Kick-off, Plattform-Einführung, erste Anwendung und Folgetermine. Auch Bestandskunden, die bisher wenig Begleitung hatten, holst du gezielt ab. Onboarding-Videos und Hilfen entwickeln: Du planst und erstellst kurze, verständliche Videos zur Plattform sowie Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen, Checklisten und Antworten auf häufige Fragen – eigenständig oder gemeinsam mit Kollegen. Du baust eine gut auffindbare Wissensbasis auf, mit der Kunden typische Fragen selbst klären können. Skalierbare Abläufe und Automatisierung gestalten: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Arbeit und entwickelst sinnvolle Lösungen, zum Beispiel für Terminbuchung, Onboarding-Erinnerungen, Aufgabenübergaben und Nachverfolgung. Du nutzt passende digitale Werkzeuge und setzt um, was du selbst umsetzen kannst. Programmierung, Schnittstellen und komplexere technische Umsetzung übernimmst du gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Kollegen; du musst dafür nicht selbst programmieren können. Aus Kundensicht denken: Du verstehst, was Kunden beim Einstieg brauchen, wo Unsicherheit entsteht und welche Informationen sie wann wirklich weiterbringen. Du gestaltest das Onboarding verständlich, in passenden Schritten und ohne Informationsüberflutung. Dabei verbindest du Einfühlungsvermögen und ein Verständnis für Lernen, Motivation und Vertrauen mit konkreten Hilfen für den Arbeitsalltag. Persönlichen Kundenkontakt halten: Du führst Teams-Meetings und Telefonate, erklärst Funktionen verständlich und begleitest Kunden bei ihren nächsten Schritten. Du erkennst, welche Fragen eine persönliche Antwort brauchen und welche sich durch gute Inhalte oder Prozesse einfacher lösen lassen. Anliegen bis zur Klärung nachhalten: Du nimmst Rückfragen und Probleme auf, priorisierst sie mit dem Team und koordinierst technische Themen mit Entwicklung und Technik. title: Legal AI Engineer (Berlin or Leipzig)
description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold. 1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus. 2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves. Meet the team in Leipzig or Berlin. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


Your mission

Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


Your profile

The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.


Why us?

  • Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
  • No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
  • We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
  • Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
  • Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
  • Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.


Process

  1. Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
  2. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
  3. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
  4. Meet the team in Leipzig or Berlin.
  5. A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. What you will work on Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature. You should bring: Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA , and GPU scheduling The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility Very good English; German is a plus We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience. Nice to have Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF , photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others! You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity. Develop yourself! raw.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
raw.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

title: Anwendungsarchitekt - Full-Stack Java/Spring, React, K8s (m/w/d)
description: Du wirst Teil eines KI-nativen Start-ups in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, dessen Produkt seinen Product-Market-Fit bereits unter Beweis gestellt hat. Wir entwickeln modernste KI-Lösungen für Governance, Risikomanagement und Compliance (GRC) für Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden sind Auditoren, Risikomanager und Compliance-Teams. Deshalb sind gründliche Evaluierung, Auditierbarkeit und die Vorbereitung auf die Anforderungen der EU-KI-Verordnung für uns keine nachträglichen Ergänzungen, sondern feste Produktanforderungen. Aufgaben Als Anwendungsarchitekt (m/w/d) gehörst du zu unseren ersten Senior-Entwicklern in Vollzeit und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mitgründer und CTO zusammen. Du verantwortest die Backend-Architektur und hilfst dem Team, Qualität und Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit mit dem Wachstum zu steigern. In den ersten 6–12 Monaten wirst du: eine klare Zielarchitektur und eine solide Dokumentationsgrundlage mit arc42 etablieren; das zentrale Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien präzisieren und im Team vermitteln; einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess einführen und standardisieren – von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung; die Entwicklungspraxis durch Coaching, Pair Programming und Feedbackschleifen stärken, insbesondere für Junior-Entwickler; die Zuverlässigkeit und Softwareauslieferung durch bessere CI/CD-Prozesse , Testautomatisierung und eine sauber gepflegte Infrastruktur verbessern. Verantwortlichkeiten Gemeinsam mit dem Team überzeugende Lösungen für neuartige Problemstellungen in einer AI-first-Architektur entwickeln. Einen DevOps-orientierten Ansatz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben: von der Spezifikation über die Entwicklung bis zur Auslieferung – inspiriert vom DevOps Handbook . Ansätze vorschlagen und umsetzen, die die Softwareauslieferung schneller und zuverlässiger machen, etwa durch einen besseren Arbeitsfluss, kürzere Feedbackschleifen und eine schnellere Wiederherstellung nach Störungen. Systemübergreifendes Monitoring und Observability aufbauen und weiterentwickeln – einschließlich Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alarmierung –, damit wir Probleme frühzeitig erkennen und aus dem Produktivbetrieb lernen. Junior-Entwickler coachen und gemeinsam mit ihnen bewährte Entwicklungs-, Design- und Architekturpraktiken anwenden. Zusammen mit dem Team einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess gestalten, von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung. Die Backend-Architektur mit dem arc42-Framework planen und dokumentieren. Das Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien erweitern und verständlich vermitteln. Die Anwendungsinfrastruktur auf Azure mit Pulumi verwalten und ausbauen. Qualifikation Unverzichtbare Voraussetzungen Erfahrung mit dem arc42-Framework (ISAQB) und C4 . Erfahrung darin, Entwicklungsteams zu führen und zu befähigen . Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Java Spring Boot (MVC, JPA, Security) . Fundierte Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmustern und Domain-Driven Design . Hervorragende Codequalität auf Basis von Clean-Code- und SOLID-Prinzipien . Umfassende Erfahrung mit TDD und BDD . Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung mit React und Angular . Darüber hinaus überzeugst du mit … Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code auf Azure oder AWS mit Pulumi. Einer ausgeprägten DevOps-Mentalität – das DevOps Handbook ist deine Bibel – und Erfahrung beim Aufbau von: zuverlässigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Release-Prozessen; produktionsreifem Monitoring und Observability sowie Verfahren zur Reaktion auf Betriebsstörungen; kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen, etwa durch die Nachbereitung von Störungen, das Lernen aus dem Betrieb und die Priorisierung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit. Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows. IntelliJ-Kenntnissen auf Power-User-Niveau. Benefits Eigenverantwortliche, praktische Arbeit an einem echten KI-Produkt, das bereits von Unternehmenskunden eingesetzt wird. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam vom ersten Tag an. Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Standort im Münchner Norden, mindestens ein Tag pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten flexibel. Bei besonders guter Passung sind wir auch offen für qualifizierte Kandidaten aus anderen Teilen der EU. Die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort im Büro statt. Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups. Die Möglichkeit, unser KI-Team mitzugestalten, während wir wachsen. Auxilius ai entwickelt KI-gestützte GRC-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Wir befinden uns in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, wachsen schnell und können bereits auf echte Kunden bauen. Unser Technologie-Stack umfasst Java und Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes auf Azure sowie LLMs von OpenAI und Anthropic. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Unsere Kunden sind Auditoren, Risikomanager und Compliance-Teams. Deshalb sind gründliche Evaluierung, Auditierbarkeit und die Vorbereitung auf die Anforderungen der EU-KI-Verordnung für uns keine nachträglichen Ergänzungen, sondern feste Produktanforderungen.

Aufgaben

Als Anwendungsarchitekt (m/w/d) gehörst du zu unseren ersten Senior-Entwicklern in Vollzeit und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mitgründer und CTO zusammen. Du verantwortest die Backend-Architektur und hilfst dem Team, Qualität und Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit mit dem Wachstum zu steigern.

In den ersten 6–12 Monaten wirst du:

  • eine klare Zielarchitektur und eine solide Dokumentationsgrundlage mit arc42 etablieren;
  • das zentrale Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien präzisieren und im Team vermitteln;
  • einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess einführen und standardisieren – von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung;
  • die Entwicklungspraxis durch Coaching, Pair Programming und Feedbackschleifen stärken, insbesondere für Junior-Entwickler;
  • die Zuverlässigkeit und Softwareauslieferung durch bessere CI/CD-Prozesse, Testautomatisierung und eine sauber gepflegte Infrastruktur verbessern.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Team überzeugende Lösungen für neuartige Problemstellungen in einer AI-first-Architektur entwickeln.
  • Einen DevOps-orientierten Ansatz über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben: von der Spezifikation über die Entwicklung bis zur Auslieferung – inspiriert vom DevOps Handbook.
  • Ansätze vorschlagen und umsetzen, die die Softwareauslieferung schneller und zuverlässiger machen, etwa durch einen besseren Arbeitsfluss, kürzere Feedbackschleifen und eine schnellere Wiederherstellung nach Störungen.
  • Systemübergreifendes Monitoring und Observability aufbauen und weiterentwickeln – einschließlich Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alarmierung –, damit wir Probleme frühzeitig erkennen und aus dem Produktivbetrieb lernen.
  • Junior-Entwickler coachen und gemeinsam mit ihnen bewährte Entwicklungs-, Design- und Architekturpraktiken anwenden.
  • Zusammen mit dem Team einen KI-getriebenen Entwicklungsprozess gestalten, von der Feature-Spezifikation bis zur Bereitstellung in der Produktionsumgebung.
  • Die Backend-Architektur mit dem arc42-Framework planen und dokumentieren.
  • Das Domänenmodell anhand von DDD-Prinzipien erweitern und verständlich vermitteln.
  • Die Anwendungsinfrastruktur auf Azure mit Pulumi verwalten und ausbauen.

Qualifikation

Unverzichtbare Voraussetzungen

  • Erfahrung mit dem arc42-Framework (ISAQB) und C4.
  • Erfahrung darin, Entwicklungsteams zu führen und zu befähigen.
  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Java Spring Boot (MVC, JPA, Security).
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Entwurfsmustern und Domain-Driven Design.
  • Hervorragende Codequalität auf Basis von Clean-Code- und SOLID-Prinzipien.
  • Umfassende Erfahrung mit TDD und BDD.
  • Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung mit React und Angular.

Darüber hinaus überzeugst du mit …

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code auf Azure oder AWS mit Pulumi.
  • Einer ausgeprägten DevOps-Mentalität – das DevOps Handbook ist deine Bibel – und Erfahrung beim Aufbau von:
  • zuverlässigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Release-Prozessen;
  • produktionsreifem Monitoring und Observability sowie Verfahren zur Reaktion auf Betriebsstörungen;
  • kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen, etwa durch die Nachbereitung von Störungen, das Lernen aus dem Betrieb und die Priorisierung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows.
  • IntelliJ-Kenntnissen auf Power-User-Niveau.

Benefits

  • Eigenverantwortliche, praktische Arbeit an einem echten KI-Produkt, das bereits von Unternehmenskunden eingesetzt wird.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam vom ersten Tag an.
  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Standort im Münchner Norden, mindestens ein Tag pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten flexibel. Bei besonders guter Passung sind wir auch offen für qualifizierte Kandidaten aus anderen Teilen der EU. Die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort im Büro statt.
  • Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups.
  • Die Möglichkeit, unser KI-Team mitzugestalten, während wir wachsen.

Auxilius ai entwickelt KI-gestützte GRC-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Wir befinden uns in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase, wachsen schnell und können bereits auf echte Kunden bauen. Unser Technologie-Stack umfasst Java und Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes auf Azure sowie LLMs von OpenAI und Anthropic.

SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features. Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued. Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage. Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture. Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed. In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop modern learning programs, deliver engaging training experiences, and play a key role in strengthening the success of our sales and partner organizations. You design modern training concepts and define appropriate methodologies and instructional approaches to enable sustainable knowledge transfer. You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives. You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs. You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations. You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners. You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics. You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs. You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way. You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions. You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN. You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions.
