title: Werkstudent:in AI & Automation (m/w/d)
description: Dafür brauchen wir Dich Du hast Lust, KI und Automatisierung nicht nur zu verstehen, sondern wirklich anzuwenden? Intelligente Prozesse, Business Software und neue Technologien begeistern Dich und Du willst Dein Wissen in echten Projekten vertiefen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Lerne in unserem Bereich Business Intelligence & Process Automation digitale Strukturen und Herausforderungen in einem stark wachsenden und innovativen Unternehmen kennen! Agentische KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst KI bei smartvillage in den echten Einsatz: nicht als Spielwiese, sondern in produktiven Prozessen. Du unterstützt beim Bau LLM-basierter Agenten und Automatisierungen, konzipierst Prompt- und Context-Design, bindest APIs an und sorgst für saubere, verlässliche Outputs inklusive sinnvoller Human-in-the-Loop-Logik. Prozesse automatisieren: Ein klarer Schwerpunkt liegt am Anfang im Finance-Bereich. Du nimmst Dir konkrete Abläufe vor: Rechnungsverarbeitung, Abstimmungen, Reporting-Workflows und KPI-Dashboards werden mit KI und Automatisierung smarter. Dabei lernst Du nebenbei, wie modernes Controlling und Accounting in einem wachsenden Unternehmen funktioniert. Automatisierung im ganzen Unternehmen: Finance ist der Start, nicht das Ende. Du nimmst Dir eigenständig Prozesse aus verschiedenen Bereichen vor, erkennst Automatisierungspotenziale und setzt sie um. Dabei nutzt Du Tools wie n8n, Make oder Python-Skripte und bindest Automatisierungen an unser CRM (HubSpot) und weitere interne Systeme an. Integration & Systemlandschaft: Du verbindest Deine Automatisierungen mit unserer bestehenden Infrastruktur: HubSpot, PostgreSQL und interne Anwendungen. Du sorgst für saubere Datenflüsse zwischen den Bereichen und denkst in Systemen, nicht in Silos. Qualität & Weiterentwicklung: Du hilfst mit, unsere KI-Anwendungen testbar und verlässlich zu machen: über Evals, Monitoring und nachvollziehbare Eskalationsmechanismen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie KI bei smartvillage weiter wächst. Das bringst Du mit Laufendes Studium mit Tech-Bezug: Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, BWL mit Technologiefokus, Ingenieurswesen oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang im Bachelor oder Master. Finance-Kenntnisse aus dem Studium oder Praktika sind ein klares Plus. Erste LLM-Praxis & Coding-Basis: Du hast bereits mit LLM-APIs gearbeitet und kennst Konzepte wie Function Calling, strukturierte Outputs oder RAG. Sauberer Python-Code, SQL-Grundkenntnisse und der Umgang mit APIs und Git sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Tool-Affinität & Automatisierungs-Know-how: Du weißt, wie man Systeme sinnvoll miteinander verbindet. Erfahrung mit Workflow-Tools wie n8n oder Make, mit HubSpot oder anderen CRM-Tools sowie Excel-Kenntnisse mit Makros oder Power Query sind ein Plus, kein Muss. Prozessverständnis & Pragmatismus: Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse wirklich laufen, bevor Du sie automatisierst. Du hinterfragst Abläufe kritisch, denkst in Zusammenhängen und weißt, wann ein simpler Workflow reicht und wann es mehr braucht. Du arbeitest selbstständig und treibst Dinge proaktiv voran. Kommunikationsstärke & Teamgeist: Du kannst technische Themen auch nicht-technischen Kolleg:innen verständlich erklären und arbeitest gerne teamübergreifend. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch. Das bieten wir Dir Werte, mit denen wir einen Unterschied machen: Wir machen Versprechen, die wir halten, haben Werte, die wir leben und eine Mission, für eine grünere Zukunft. Erfahre mehr dazu hier . Performance trifft auf Wohlfühlklima: Wir setzen auf eine professionelle und dynamische Arbeitsatmosphäre. Wir vertreten die Meinung, dass das nur möglich ist, wenn unsere Mitarbeiter:innen glücklich sind und wir ein unterstützendes Miteinander bieten. Wir möchten, dass Du Dich im smartvillage nicht nur wohl, sondern auch wertgeschätzt fühlst. Persönliche Entwicklung & Eigenverantwortung: In unserem teamorientierten Umfeld hast Du viel Raum für Kreativität und Eigeninitiative. Wir bieten Dir eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit, in der Du Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Durch unser Fortbildungsbudget hast Du zusätzlich die Möglichkeit, Dich persönlich und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits im Alltag: Sichere Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge über unseren Partner DYNO. Für Deine nachhaltige Mobilität bezuschussen wir dein DB-Ticket. Und weil Arbeit mehr ist als nur der Job, stärken wir unseren Teamzusammenhalt durch regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsame Ausflüge. Stay hydrated & stay fit: Dein Office bietet kostenlose Getränke und mit einem Entspannungsbereich für unsere smarties einen Ort für Erholungen zwischendurch. Wenn Du sportlich aktiv werden willst, bezuschussen wir Dir Deine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft. Klingt wie ein Traum? Finden wir zwar auch, ist es aber nicht! raw.title: Product Designer (m/f/d)- Physical Products & AI - home decor brand - 100% remote - part-/fulltime
raw.description:
For my client, an established direct-to-consumer home decor brand, I’m looking for a talented Product Designer to join the team on a long-term basis.

The company creates distinctive wooden home decor for customers primarily in the US, with a strong focus on wall art alongside selected freestanding pieces.

We’re looking for someone who combines a strong design eye with commercial thinking and hands-on AI skills — someone who can turn ideas and market insights into products customers genuinely want to buy.

Tasks

Your main responsibility will be to develop new, sellable physical products from idea to launch.

You’ll identify promising product opportunities through a mix of market and competitor research, emerging trends, existing bestsellers and your own creative ideas.

From there, you’ll take concepts through the full development process:

  • Create and visualize new product concepts using AI image-generation tools
  • Refine ideas into commercially viable product directions
  • Collaborate with CAD designers to translate concepts into manufacturable designs
  • Work with suppliers and factories throughout sampling and development
  • Coordinate with the content and advertising teams to prepare products for launch
  • Manage several product concepts and development projects in parallel

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with AI image generation, using tools such as Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, Flux or similar
  • Experience designing physical products — not solely graphic, digital or UX/UI design
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, form and commercial product design, demonstrated through a portfolio
  • Highly organized, reliable and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Fluent English

Strong Plus

  • Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors or lifestyle products
  • A background working with wood, handcrafted products or similar materials
  • A strong understanding of US home decor trends and customer preferences
  • Experience collaborating with factories, manufacturers or suppliers, including product sampling and iterations

Benefits

What You Can Expect

  • 🌍 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • ⏰ Flexible setup – part-time or full-time both possible
  • 🚀 High level of ownership over new products from the earliest idea through launch
  • 🎨 Creative freedom to explore trends, concepts and entirely new product directions
  • 🤖 AI-first product development environment, with modern tools integrated into the creative process
  • 📈 Steep learning curve across product development, eCommerce and performance-driven product launches
  • 🤝 International, entrepreneurial team with fast decision-making and close collaboration
  • 📦 Direct exposure to the full product lifecycle, from concept and sampling to content, advertising and launch
  • 🔄 Long-term collaboration with consistent opportunities to develop and launch new products
  • 🚀 Start as soon as possible

If you’re a product designer who enjoys combining creativity, AI, commercial thinking and hands-on physical product development, I’d be happy to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, portfolio and a few examples of products or concepts you’ve personally developed.

title: Werkstudent Office Management (all genders)
description: Aufgaben Unser Office Management ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – mit einem offenen Ohr, einem freundlichen Lächeln und einer guten Portion Organisationstalent sorgt ihr gemeinsam dafür, dass der Arbeitsalltag rundläuft, kleine und große Anliegen schnell gelöst werden und sich alle Kolleg:innen bei uns nicht nur unterstützt, sondern auch willkommen und wohlfühlen. Als Werkstudent:in im Office Management sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Teams nicht nur produktiv, sondern auch mit einem Lächeln durch den Tag gehen. Büroabläufe gestalten : Du unterstützt bei der effizienten Organisation unserer täglichen Büroabläufe (z. B. Catering, liebevolle Ausstattung der Konferenzräume oder die Pflege unserer Kaffeemaschinen). Erste Ansprechperson sein : Du bearbeitest selbstständig den Post- sowie E-Mail-Eingang und stehst unseren Kolleg:innen sowie externen Besucher:innen persönlich und telefonisch stets hilfsbereit zur Seite. Events mitgestalten : Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer internen Company Days – ob bei der Vorbereitung oder am Tag selbst: Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass aus einem normalen Arbeitstag etwas ganz Besonderes wird. Anforderungen Laufendes Studium: Du befindest Dich mitten im Studium, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor Dir und kannst uns mit ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche tatkräftig unterstützen. Positive Ausstrahlung: Deine gute Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, neue Herausforderungen mit einem Lächeln zu meistern, und durch Deine positive Einstellung trägst Du zu einem tollen Miteinander bei. Service im Blut: Deine Arbeitsweise zeichnet sich insbesondere durch eine hohe Serviceorientierung und ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail aus. Selbstständigkeit: Du bist strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst Aufgaben gerne eigeninitiativ an. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- sowie solide Englischkenntnisse mit und hast Spaß daran, Neues dazuzulernen. Was wir bieten Raum zu wachsen // Bleib neugierig: In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deiner Führungskraft Deinen ganz persönlichen Entwicklungspfad. Hinzu kommen informative Workshops, die Dir neuen Input geben und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern. Mentale und körperliche Gesundheit // Bleib gesund & aktiv : Wir möchten, dass es Dir gut geht und unterstützen Deine Gesundheit durch eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club. Zusätzlich steht unser Kooperationspartner “Fürstenberg Institut” Dir und Deinen Familienangehörigen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite, wenn es um mentale Gesundheit & Coaching geht. Verantwortungsbewusstsein // We #care: Um unsere Welt ein kleines bisschen besser zu machen, fördert unser ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) unser Bewusstsein für umweltschonendes Verhalten. Zusätzlich arbeiten wir mit JobRad, bieten ein vergünstigtes BVG Ticket an und unterstützen bei unserem jährlichen Social Day tatkräftig soziale Projekte in Berlin. Wir packen mit an, um unserem Planeten und unseren Mitmenschen etwas zurückzugeben. Teamspirit // Bleib vernetzt: Was uns antreibt, ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Deshalb veranstalten wir regelmäßig unseren Company-Office-Day, an dem alle zusammenkommen. Neben einem umfassenden Update unseres C-Boards steht hier vor allem das Miteinander und der Austausch im Fokus. Transparenz // Wir möchten transparent sein - auch bei dem Thema Gehalt: Wenn Du Fragen zu einer möglichen Gehaltsspanne für diese Position hast, sende uns gerne eine E-Mail an ----- Wir melden uns dann so schnell wie möglich bei Dir. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.</p> <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="184" data-end="439">&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.</p> <p data-start="441" data-end="780">&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.</p> <p data-start="782" data-end="1078">&nbsp;</p> <h1 data-section-id="1b5pyf7" data-start="1080" data-end="1096">What you'll do</h1> <h3 data-section-id="1rd6iho" data-start="1098" data-end="1136">Advise on AI trust and governance.</h3> <p data-start="1137" data-end="1641">Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1vy74ta" data-start="1643" data-end="1681">Scope and shape AI build projects.</h3> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1elmp9s" data-start="2123" data-end="2145">Build and deliver.</h3> <p data-start="2146" data-end="2546">Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.</p> <h3 data-section-id="8xgjwk" data-start="2548" data-end="2590">Own the relationship through delivery.</h3> <p data-start="2591" data-end="2805">Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.</p> <h1 data-section-id="kq6nv6" data-start="2807" data-end="2831">What we're looking for</h1> <h2 data-section-id="1wfooam" data-start="2833" data-end="2846">Must-haves</h2> <ul data-start="2848" data-end="4211"> <li data-section-id="1savupk" data-start="2848" data-end="3035">5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).</li> <li data-section-id="qxlgzp" data-start="3036" data-end="3234">Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.</li> <li data-section-id="5cohv6" data-start="3235" data-end="3474"><strong data-start="3237" data-end="3268">Machine Learning Expertise:</strong> Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.</li> <li data-section-id="4qgzw0" data-start="3475" data-end="3667">Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.</li> <li data-section-id="u9bkd2" data-start="3668" data-end="3894">Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.</li> <li data-section-id="i43vcd" data-start="3895" data-end="4098">Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.</li> <li data-section-id="16b5uac" data-start="4099" data-end="4211">Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.</li> </ul> <h2 data-section-id="gbyf8a" data-start="4213" data-end="4229">Strong pluses</h2> <ul data-start="4231" data-end="5098"> <li data-section-id="otf7d0" data-start="4231" data-end="4368">Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.</li> <li data-section-id="1457rsl" data-start="4369" data-end="4515">Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).</li> <li data-section-id="1l5daxl" data-start="4516" data-end="4648">Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).</li> <li data-section-id="3crjn8" data-start="4649" data-end="4791">Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.</li> <li data-section-id="1h63k2g" data-start="4792" data-end="4936">Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.</li> <li data-section-id="1d0p8e3" data-start="4937" data-end="5036">Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.</li> <li data-section-id="49tosn" data-start="5037" data-end="5098">Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1 data-section-id="1bghwns" data-start="5100" data-end="5127">How we'll measure success</h1> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.</p> <p data-start="5129" data-end="5421">&nbsp;</p> <h1 data-section-id="yoij66" data-start="5423" data-end="5447">Why this role, why now</h1> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893">AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.</p> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893">&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="5449" data-end="5893"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-SB1</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-teams="true"><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak">Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our <a id="menur12n" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://www.avepoint.com/company/privacy-notice" target="_blank">Privacy Notice</a>.</span></span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit&nbsp;<span><a href="http://yext.com" target="_blank">yext.com</a></span>.</p></div><p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise, </strong>to drive adoption and maximize the value of the Yext platform with a strong commitment to learning. You will be responsible for partnering with enterprise customers, understanding their priorities and pain points, and ensuring that they optimize their Yext investment. CSMs play an integral role in our business, working closely with sales, solution engineers, product management, and GTM teams.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a portfolio of assigned customers, with a focus on increasing adoption, ensuring retention and growth, and overall customer satisfaction</li> <li>Be a trusted Partner:&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li>Build and maintain strong relationships with Yext customers, serving as their primary point of contact for all post-sales activities.</li> <li>Work with Yext Support, Product Management,&nbsp; Services, and GTM teams to share customer feedback and act as an internal advocate for our customers</li> <li>Be an expert on the Yext platform and products</li> </ul> <li>Drive Adoption and Optimization:</li> <ul> <li>Partner with customers to develop and execute strategic success plans, aligning Yext solutions with their business objectives and goals.</li> <li>Conduct regular reviews, provide progress updates related to reactive issues and proactive customer initiatives, and demonstrate the value of Yext products and services</li> </ul> <li>Deliver Industry Insights and Yext Product Expertise:</li> <ul> <li>Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices and share insights and recommendations with customers&nbsp;</li> <li>Share product roadmap with customers, provide guidance on how new Yext&nbsp; features and offerings align with customer’s business objectives and help with achieving KPIs&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li>Identify Opportunities for Growth:</li> <ul> <li>Analyzing customer data to identify upsell &amp; cross sell opportunities</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales and Solution Engineering to pursue growth opportunities&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li>Renewals &amp; Risk Management:</li> <ul> <li>Demonstrate keen situational awareness, adept at deciphering subtle cues and anticipating potential risks ahead of time, taking preemptive measures to mitigate them effectively. Above and beyond attitude to restore and maintain positive sentiment.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales on renewals strategy and plans, leveraging customer analytics and metrics to maintain outlined retention goals</li> <li>Provide accurate renewals forecast</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>What You Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>BA/BS degree in Sales,&nbsp; Business, Marketing, or Computer Science preferred</li> <li>A minimum of 7 years of experience in a strategic CSM role with a proven track record of managing enterprise-level customers.</li> <li>Knowledge of digital marketing technologies - social media marketing platforms, digital experience platforms, reputation management, customer experience platforms, marketing performance management</li> <li>Familiarity with different listings networks such as Google, Apple, and Facebook and experience with marketing strategies for multi-location businesses&nbsp;</li> <li>Work experience in organic search/ local SEO within digital media preferred</li> <li>Strong ability to develop insights from performance data and present a value story to key stakeholders</li> <li>Experience with subscription GTM approaches for customer success management and renewals</li> <li>Proven ability to manage a book of business with high gross retention &amp; predictability</li> <li>Customer-centric mindset - put the customer's needs first, actively seek feedback, and continuously strive to improve the customer's experience with the product or service.</li> <li>Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to anticipate customer needs, and the ability to develop tailored solutions to meet them.</li> <li>Solid project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with Challenger Sales Methodology is a huge plus.</li> <li>Strong negotiation, influencing, and closing skills</li> <li>Adaptability and flexibility mindset</li> <li>Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence customers and partners at all levels</li> </ul> <p>#LI-JS2<br>#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

 

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers are the technical tip of the spear at Exa. Partnered with an Account Executive, you own the technical win: you run discovery with customer engineering teams, design solutions on Exa's API, build and deliver demos and POCs that prove value, and turn technical evaluations into closed deals. You'll be one of the first GTM engineers in your region — you'll help define how Exa sells there, not just execute a playbook.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical side of the sales cycle: discovery, solution design, demos, POCs/POVs, and technical objection handling, in partnership with your AE

  • Run the technical side of expansion: spot new use cases in existing accounts and turn them into evaluations, with your AE

  • Build working demos and prototypes on Exa's API tailored to each customer's use case — agents, research, search, enrichment

  • Tell the story: translate Exa's capabilities into use-case narratives that land with CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike

  • Be the trusted technical advisor: know Exa inside out — the product, the API, the problems it solves — answer hard questions honestly, run evaluations rigorously, and know when to pull in engineering

  • Feed the field back into product: identify patterns across customer evaluations and channel them to product and engineering

  • Scale yourself and the region: build reusable demos, integration patterns, and playbooks, and represent Exa at technical workshops, meetups, and conferences

  • As a founding regional hire, support early customers through onboarding and initial implementation while we build out dedicated post-sales

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (flexible for exceptional candidates) — solutions/sales engineering, solutions architecture, or an engineering role with heavy customer exposure (e.g., engineering lead, developer relations, technical consulting)

  • Technical depth with APIs and modern development (e.g. Python or TypeScript): you can design an integration, build a working demo, and debug it live — using AI-assisted tooling is expected, hand-crafted code is not the bar

  • Strong communication and presentation skills: you can command a room, adapt to your audience, and say "I don't know — I'll find out" when you don't

  • Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage intensity: you can run several evaluations in parallel, prioritize what moves deals, and your job description will change as the region grows

  • Familiarity with the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, agents — and how customers evaluate it; you can scope a POC with clear success criteria

  • Based in region with willingness to travel for customer engagements

You might excel if you…

  • Have owned technical evaluations at a developer-platform / API-first company — POCs/POVs you scoped and ran that ended in a customer going live

  • Have led engineers and want to move toward the customer, or are an SE who wants to be more hands-on than your last role allowed

  • Are genuinely curious about AI and have built things with LLMs — side projects count

  • Are energized by being the first: first hire, first deal, first playbook in a region

  • Have run enterprise evaluations end-to-end — POC success criteria, security questionnaires, RFP responses

  • Speak additional regional languages (a plus across APJ markets)

 

This is an in-person opportunity in London. In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT BUILDING LEADERS, SHAPING CULTURE, AND ENABLING BUSINESS SUCCESS

The Senior Director, People & Culture is a pivotal senior role within our London Office and a key member of Catapult's global P&C leadership team. Working three days in the office and partnering closely with senior business leaders, you will drive strategic impact while shaping both the culture and operational effectiveness of the EMEA region.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, based in Melbourne, you will lead an in-region team of three and be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enable, engage, develop and retain exceptional talent.

Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution. You will thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and be energised by creating innovative, scalable solutions that strengthen leadership capability and foster a high-performance culture across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Develop and execute strategic workforce plans, coaching senior leaders on organisational design, change management, communication, and talent development to drive engagement, retention, and business performance.
  • Shape culture and values by identifying organisational needs and implementing impactful, scalable people solutions.
  • Drive a consistent, high-quality employee experience across the EMEA region, spanning three offices, 16 countries, and multiple employment frameworks.
  • Provide hands-on support and strategic partnership to leaders, teams, and employees, ensuring people strategies are aligned with business goals.
  • Partner with the Talent team to deliver strategic initiatives across learning and development, diversity, equity and inclusion, reward, workforce planning, and talent acquisition.
  • Mentor and lead regional P&C team members, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Leverage data and insights to identify trends, inform decision-making, and influence strategic outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A commercial mindset and the ability to connect people decisions to business outcomes, building credibility and influence with senior leaders across regions and cultures.
  • Significant People & Culture leadership experience in a multi-country EMEA environment, with working knowledge of UK and German employment law.
  • Proven success partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth, global organisation to drive transformation and business outcomes.
  • The ability to balance competing priorities across the employee lifecycle without compromising quality or attention to detail.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex challenges.
  • A strategic yet hands-on approach, balancing pace with employee development, engagement, and belonging.
  • Experience designing creative, commercially driven solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • A passion for creating a market-leading employee experience and fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Flexibility to work across global time zones when required.

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months, you have built strong relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders and are recognised as a trusted P&C partner. You have a clear understanding of workforce opportunities, challenges, and priorities, with a defined view of how P&C can enable business performance. Your direct team is aligned on priorities, ways of working, and expectations, and regional P&C processes are operating with consistency and quality.
  • In 12 months time, you are driving meaningful impact through strategic workforce initiatives, stronger leadership capability, and an enhanced employee experience. Leaders are empowered to navigate people challenges effectively, global P&C initiatives are successfully embedded across teams, and data and insights are being used to inform decisions. You are a valued member of the global P&C leadership team, helping shape and deliver a high-performance culture across Catapult.

 

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

  • Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.

  • Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.

  • Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

  • Collaboration & feedback: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.

This Role Is For You If

  • You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results

  • You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new

  • You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly

  • You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort

  • You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure

  • You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates

  • You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared

Our Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.

  • First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)

  • One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)

  • Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side

This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped

Time off & flexibility

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

  • You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them.

  • Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource.

  • Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven.

  • Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it.

What we're looking for

  • AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal?
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you.

  • You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

  • You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

Commercial Service frameworks), security classifications, and accreditation processes is highly valuable.</li> <li>Ability to lead consultative technical discovery and engage confidently with senior customers, prospects, and partners across government, defence, and industry in both business and technical conversations.</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to or through channel partners and defence industrial base primes and SMEs is highly valuable, as partner enablement is a significant part of the role.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and follow-through.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Completed enhanced UK Government security vetting required.</strong></li> <li><em>Note: this role can be based remotely anywhere in the UK. Regular travel across the UK to be on-site with customers and partners should be expected as a core part of the role.</em></li> </ul> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Lendable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

  1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops. What you'll do Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out Essential experience . Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost Highly preferred Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML Logistics Compensation is highly competitive. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it.

We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK.

The role
You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops.

What you'll do

  • Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics

  • Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction

  • Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models

  • Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out

Essential experience.

  • Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods

  • A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity

  • Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost

Highly preferred

  • Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization

  • You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before

  • Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.


What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.
